## Description
Brief summary of what this PR changes and why.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor (no functional change)

## Checklist
- [ ] `go test -race -count=1 ./...` passes locally
- [ ] `golangci-lint run ./...` passes locally
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes locally
- [ ] Coverage stays at or above 70% on touched packages
- [ ] New / changed public APIs have godoc comments
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG updated where relevant
- [ ] ADR added for significant architectural changes
- [ ] No new module dependencies added (or new dep is justified in PR description)
